definitions.explanation: Being the only one of its kind. Nothing else exists in the same category.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{唯一|ゆいいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧です。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{唯一|ゆいいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生存者|せいぞんしゃ}でした。

⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{唯一|ゆいいつ}です。
examples.english: She is the only one on the team who can speak Japanese.

notes:
{唯一|ゆいいつ} emphasizes that something is the only one of its kind, with absolutely no alternatives or equivalents.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の + noun: the only ~ ({唯一|ゆいいつ}の{方法|ほうほう}, the only method)
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}{無二|むに}: one and only, absolutely unique
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}の{例外|れいがい}: the sole exception

SIMILAR WORDS:
- たった{一|ひと}つ: only one (casual, spoken)
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}: only, sole (formal, written)
- {独自|どくじ}: unique, original (focuses on distinctiveness)
- ただ{一|ひと}つ: the one and only (literary)

USAGE:
Functions as both a noun and a no-adjective. More formal and emphatic than たった{一|ひと}つ. Common in written language and formal speech.
